loginLede: Sign in to operate the demo crane
pinHint: Type the value from .env. This demo uses the admin password: change-me-admin-password
holdHint: Hold motion buttons: deadman pulses while pressed. Release to stop.
phoneVoiceHint: UP and DOWN always work. Listen needs a local debug build (npx expo run:android), not Expo Go.
err.motion: Motion blocked: hold deadman and ensure normal safety mode
err.pin: SAFE_ACTION_PIN does not match. Type the value from .env (this demo uses the admin password), not the name SAFE_ACTION_PIN.
err.face: Face match failed — use password login
tour.offHint: Turn on Tour help to see tips on every control.
tour.login.language: Pick English or Español. Your choice can be saved on your user after sign-in.
tour.login.password: Your login password from the server .env (demo admin password).
tour.login.signIn: Signs you in and opens the operator control screen.
tour.login.face: Optional face login — local challenge liveness, not ISO-certified.
tour.operator.nav: Jump to Media, Assistant, Face, Ops, Config, Audit, or log out.
tour.operator.banner: Safety mode at a glance: normal means you may move; e_stop blocks motion; deadman HOLD shows while you hold a move.
tour.operator.graphic: Plant picture with live labels (height, load, motor) from the PLC.
tour.operator.safePin: Secret PIN required for STOP and other safe actions. Demo value is in .env (SAFE_ACTION_PIN).
tour.operator.matrix: Control buttons. Hold motion cells (Hoist/Trolley); tap STOP only after typing the PIN.
tour.operator.holdHint: Press and hold to move. Release to stop. Deadman pulses while held.
tour.media.camera: Device camera preview. Grant permission to scan QR codes in the frame.
tour.media.qr: Type or scan a known code (e.g. TP-CRANE-DEMO-01) to jump to a screen.
tour.media.voice: Browser or phone speech: say up or down. Only allowlisted words run motion.
tour.media.upDown: Fallback buttons that send the same hoist commands without a microphone.
tour.ops.diagnostics: PLC link, safety mode, watchdog, and API uptime.
tour.ops.alarms: Active, acknowledged, or shelved alarms from your alarm rules.
tour.ops.ack: Ack means you saw the alarm. Shelve hides it temporarily. Neither fixes the machine alone.
tour.ops.trends: Simple history charts for registers marked Trend in Config.
tour.face.title: Face enroll and login with a 3-pose challenge. Fail closed to password if the match is weak.
tour.face.enroll: Capture a challenge template after password login. Local liveness; not ISO-certified.
tour.face.login: Match the challenge frames to the stored template, then open Operator.
tour.audit.title: Who changed settings or triggered important actions.
tour.audit.list: Each row shows user, action, resource, result, and time.
tour.assistant.title: Search manuals with local FTS — Cursor Agent optional if CURSOR_API_KEY is set.
tour.assistant.ask: Ask about deadman, Modbus, alarms, wiring, and more in plain language.
tour.config.plc: PLC host, port, unit id, protocol (Modbus TCP or OPC UA), and which connection is active.
tour.config.registers: Map each named register to a Modbus address (and OPC UA node id when needed). Trend checkbox stores history.
tour.config.cells: Matrix buttons: row, column, label, primary/feedback/status registers, motion and safe-action flags.
tour.config.labels: Text overlays on the plant graphic, tied to a register and format string.
tour.config.background: Name, CSS color, and optional image URL for the operator graphic.
tour.config.alarms: Create rules: name, register, compare operator, threshold, severity, enabled.
tour.config.safety: Bind E-stop, deadman, heartbeat, and safe-state registers used by supervision.
